name: Genecracer Saki
original_name: ジェネクレイサー サキ
source:
The story takes place in a little bit future. People enjoy their lives thanks to advanced medicine and science. The one who supplies their happiness is a big company called Seraph. Seraph works in the name of "for world peace" outwardly, but their secret business is to supply weapons to various countries. There are also many companies and organizations which try to compete against Seraph. To defeat them, Seraph starts inventing a new weapon called Genecracer, a battlesuit. Once you wear it, you'll get an incalculable power. But an accident occurs that Saki, who wears the battlesuit, suddenly becomes conscious of her ego during the mission and runs away with the target man (the main character). To erase the betrayer, other members are ordered to chase her.... Like this, an epic battle involving the Genecracer soldiers begins....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090712043154/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012494]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在不久後的未來。先進的醫學與科學讓人們享受著富足生活，而在背後支撐這份幸福的是名為Seraph的大企業。Seraph表面上以「為了世界和平」為口號，暗地裡卻向各國供應武器。許多企業與組織試圖和Seraph競爭，為了擊敗它們，Seraph開始研發名為Genecracer的新型戰鬥服。穿上它的人將獲得無法估量的力量。
然而一次任務中發生了意外：穿著戰鬥服的咲突然產生自我意識，並與任務目標——也就是主角——一同逃走。為了抹殺叛徒，其他成員奉命追捕她……一場圍繞Genecracer戰士展開的大規模戰鬥由此開始……
